payload.text: infra-aws 56 s vs 4 s solved: its aws/docker stubs were shell functions, and deploy.sh calls `timeout 60 aws`, which runs the real AWS CLI on GitHub runners (77 calls/run waiting on credential lookup; would reach AWS with credentials). #216 puts the stubs on PATH: 3 s, 0 real calls. #215 merged: deploy-slow parts 47-62 s on the runner (from 75-92); its PR gate 102 s (second round after the parts).
